<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Hospedagem N.Sra Menina e São José Vitorioso</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,500;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=Jost:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  :root {
    --cream: #F9F5EE;
    --cream-dark: #EDE7D8;
    --gold: #9A7B4F;
    --gold-light: #C4A97D;
    --gold-pale: #F0E6D3;
    --brown: #4A3728;
    --brown-light: #7A5C47;
    --text: #2C2018;
    --text-muted: #7A6B5D;
    --white: #FFFFFF;
    --border: rgba(154,123,79,0.25);
  }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif;
    background: var(--cream);
    color: var(--text);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.7;
  }

  /* HEADER */
  header {
    background: #F2EDD8;
    color: var(--white);
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2rem 2rem 1.5rem;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  header::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' viewBox='0 0 60 60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cg fill='none' fill-rule='evenodd'%3E%3Cg fill='%23ffffff' fill-opacity='0.03'%3E%3Cpath d='M36 34v-4h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2h-4zm0-30V0h-2v4h-4v2h4v4h2V6h4V4h-4zM6 34v-4H4v4H0v2h4v4h2v-4h4v-2H6zM6 4V0H4v4H0v2h4v4h2V6h4V4H6z'/%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/g%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  }

  .header-ornament {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.35em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold-light);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    position: relative;
  }

  .header-ornament::before,
  .header-ornament::after {
    content: '✦';
    margin: 0 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    vertical-align: middle;
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  header h1 {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 3rem);
    font-weight: 300;
    line-height: 1.2;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    color: var(--white);
    position: relative;
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  }

  header h1 em {
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--gold-light);
  }

  .header-sub {
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.25em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
    font-weight: 300;
    position: relative;
  }

  /* NAV */
  nav {
    background: var(--white);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 100;
  }

  nav ul {
    list-style: none;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0;
    max-width: 900px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  nav ul li a {
    display: block;
    padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--brown-light);
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 400;
    transition: color 0.2s, border-bottom 0.2s;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
  }

  nav ul li a:hover {
    color: var(--gold);
    border-bottom-color: var(--gold);
  }

  /* SECTIONS */
  section {
    max-width: 960px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 4rem 1.5rem;
  }

  .section-label {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.35em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    font-weight: 400;
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
  }

  .section-title {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 4vw, 2.4rem);
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 1.25;
    color: var(--brown);
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
  }

  .divider {
    width: 48px;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--gold);
    margin: 1.2rem 0 2.5rem;
  }

  /* QUARTOS */
  #quartos { background: var(--white); max-width: 100%; padding: 4rem 0; }
  #quartos > .inner { max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 1.5rem; }

  .quartos-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
    gap: 2rem;
    margin-top: 2rem;
  }

  .quarto-card {
    background: var(--cream);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: 4px;
    transition: transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s;
  }

  .quarto-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(74,55,40,0.12);
  }

  .quarto-img {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 4/3;
    background: var(--cream-dark);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.5rem;
  }

  .quarto-img img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
  }

  .img-placeholder {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    background: var(--cream-dark);
  }

  .img-placeholder svg {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    stroke: var(--gold-light);
    fill: none;
    stroke-width: 1;
  }

  .img-placeholder span {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold-light);
  }

  .img-thumbnails {
    display: flex;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 4px;
    background: var(--cream-dark);
  }

  .img-thumb {
    flex: 1;
    aspect-ratio: 1;
    background: var(--cream);
    border-radius: 2px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 0.55rem;
    color: var(--gold-light);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }

  .quarto-body {
    padding: 1.5rem;
  }

  .quarto-tag {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 0.6rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    background: var(--gold-pale);
    padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 400;
  }

  .quarto-name {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 1.35rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--brown);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    line-height: 1.2;
  }

  .quarto-desc {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
  }

  .quarto-comodidades {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 6px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding-top: 1rem;
  }

  .comod-tag {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--brown-light);
    background: var(--white);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }

  /* SOBRE */
  #sobre { background: var(--cream); }

  .sobre-grid-single {
    display: block;
    max-width: 640px;
  }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .sobre-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    nav ul { flex-wrap: wrap; }
    nav ul li a { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-size: 0.65rem; }
  }

  .sobre-text p {
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.8;
  }

  .sobre-text p strong {
    color: var(--brown);
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  .info-box {
    background: var(--white);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--gold);
    padding: 1.5rem;
    border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
  }

  .info-item {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    align-items: flex-start;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
  }

  .info-item:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

  .info-label {
    font-size: 0.65rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    font-weight: 400;
    min-width: 80px;
    padding-top: 2px;
  }

  .info-value {
    color: var(--text-muted);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* LOCALIZAÇÃO */
  #localizacao { background: var(--brown); color: var(--white); max-width: 100%; padding: 4rem 0; }
  #localizacao > .inner { max-width: 960px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 1.5rem; }
  #localizacao .section-title { color: var(--cream); }
  #localizacao .section-label { color: var(--gold-light); }

  .map-container {
    width: 100%;
    border-radius: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid rgba(154,123,79,0.3);
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
  }

  .map-container iframe {
    width: 100%;
    height: 380px;
    display: block;
    border: 0;
    filter: sepia(20%) contrast(95%);
  }

  .distancias-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px, 1fr));
    gap: 1rem;
  }

  .distancia-card {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(154,123,79,0.25);
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 1.25rem;
    transition: background 0.2s;
  }

  .distancia-card:hover {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  }

  .distancia-number {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 300;
    color: var(--gold-light);
    line-height: 1;
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  }

  .distancia-unit {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--gold-light);
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  .distancia-nome {
    font-size: 0.82rem;
    color: var(--cream);
    font-weight: 400;
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
  }

  .distancia-endereco {
    font-size: 0.72rem;
    color: rgba(249,245,238,0.45);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .distancia-loading {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--gold-light);
    opacity: 0.6;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }

  /* FOOTER */
  footer {
    background: #1E1510;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2.5rem 1.5rem;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  }

  footer strong {
    color: var(--gold-light);
    font-weight: 400;
  }

  footer p { margin-top: 0.4rem; }

  /* PHOTO GALLERY HINTS */
  .photo-hint {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    background: var(--gold-pale);
    border: 1px dashed var(--gold-light);
    padding: 6px 14px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    margin-top: 1rem;
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Logo Hospedagem N.Sra Menina e São José Vitorioso" style="max-width:100%; max-height:220px; width:auto; height:auto; display:block; margin:0 auto; position:relative;">
</header>

<nav>
  <ul>
    <li><a href="#sobre">A Hospedagem</a></li>
    <li><a href="#quartos">Acomodações</a></li>
    <li><a href="#localizacao">Localização</a></li>
    <li><a href="#contato">Contato</a></li>
  </ul>
</nav>

<!-- SOBRE -->
<section id="sobre">
  <p class="section-label">Sobre</p>
  <div class="divider"></div>

  <div class="sobre-grid-single">
    <div class="sobre-text">
      <p>A hospedagem Nossa Sra. Menina e São José Vitorioso oferece uma localização central e estratégica, com fácil acesso aos principais pontos da região. A poucos minutos da Paróquia São Judas e com deslocamento rápido para Ampare I e II, Monte Carmelo e Thabor, é o lugar ideal para quem busca praticidade, conforto e tranquilidade em uma única estadia.</p>
    </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- QUARTOS -->
<div id="quartos">
  <div class="inner">
    <p class="section-label">Acomodações</p>
    <h2 class="section-title">Quartos e ambientes</h2>
    <div class="divider"></div>

    <div class="quartos-grid">

      <!-- Quarto Familiar -->
      <div class="quarto-card">
        <div class="quarto-img" id="familiar-gallery" style="cursor:pointer;" onclick="cycleFamiliar()">
          <img id="familiar-main" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Quarto Familiar - cama casal e beliche" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;">
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;background:var(--cream-dark);">
          <div onclick="setFamiliar(0)" style="flex:1;aspect-ratio:4/3;overflow:hidden;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid var(--gold);" id="fthumb-0">
            <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;">
          </div>
          <div onclick="setFamiliar(1)" style="flex:1;aspect-ratio:4/3;overflow:hidden;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;" id="fthumb-1">
            <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="quarto-body">
          <span class="quarto-tag">Quarto Familiar</span>
          <h3 class="quarto-name">Quarto Familiar</h3>
          <div class="quarto-comodidades">
            <span class="comod-tag">Cama Casal</span>
            <span class="comod-tag">Beliche</span>
            <span class="comod-tag">Ventilador</span>
            <span class="comod-tag">Armário</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Quarto Duplo -->
      <div class="quarto-card">
        <div class="quarto-img" id="duplo-gallery" style="cursor:pointer;" onclick="cycleDuplo()">
          <img id="duplo-main" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Quarto Duplo - duas camas de solteiro" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;">
        </div>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;background:var(--cream-dark);">
          <div onclick="setDuplo(0)" style="flex:1;aspect-ratio:4/3;overflow:hidden;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid var(--gold);" id="dthumb-0">
            <img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;">
          </div>
          <div onclick="setDuplo(1)" style="flex:1;aspect-ratio:4/3;overflow:hidden;border-radius:2px;cursor:pointer;border:2px solid transparent;" id="dthumb-1">
            <img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;">
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="quarto-body">
          <span class="quarto-tag">Quarto Duplo</span>
          <h3 class="quarto-name">Quarto Duplo</h3>
          <div class="quarto-comodidades">
            <span class="comod-tag">2 Camas de Solteiro</span>
            <span class="comod-tag">Ventilador</span>
            <span class="comod-tag">Armário</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>


  </div>
</div>

<!-- LOCALIZAÇÃO -->
<div id="localizacao">
  <div class="inner">
    <p class="section-label">Como chegar</p>
    <h2 class="section-title">Localização e distâncias</h2>
    <div class="divider" style="background:rgba(154,123,79,0.5)"></div>

    <div class="map-container">
      <iframe
        src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=!1m18!1m12!1m3!1d3658.6!2d-46.6548617!3d-23.337897!2m3!1f0!2f0!3f0!3m2!1i1024!2i768!4f13.1!3m3!1m2!1s0x94ce879897a28e87%3A0xdc8bc8c6dbb90bdf!2sR.+Jos%C3%A9+Carlos+Ferreira%2C+152+-+Mairipor%C3%A3%2C+SP!5e0!3m2!1spt-BR!2sbr!4v1"
        allowfullscreen
        loading="lazy"
        referrerpolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade"
        title="Mapa da hospedagem">
      </iframe>
    </div>

    <p style="font-size:0.8rem; color:rgba(249,245,238,0.5); margin-bottom:1.5rem; letter-spacing:0.05em;">
      Distâncias aproximadas a partir da hospedagem
    </p>

    <div class="distancias-grid" id="distancias-grid">

      <div class="distancia-card">
        <div class="distancia-number" id="dist-1">
          <span class="distancia-loading">calculando...</span>
        </div>
        <div class="distancia-nome">Ampare II</div>
        <div class="distancia-endereco">Estr. Delegado Arcy de Castro Oliveira Vicente, 1800 — São Vicente, Mairiporã/SP</div>
      </div>

      <div class="distancia-card">
        <div class="distancia-number" id="dist-2">
          <span class="distancia-loading">calculando...</span>
        </div>
        <div class="distancia-nome">Paróquia N.Sra das Graças — Igreja São Judas</div>
        <div class="distancia-endereco">Rua Luciano Wisniewski, 57 — Vila Machado, Mairiporã/SP</div>
      </div>

      <div class="distancia-card">
        <div class="distancia-number" id="dist-3">
          <span class="distancia-loading">calculando...</span>
        </div>
        <div class="distancia-nome">Monte Carmelo</div>
        <div class="distancia-endereco">Rua Fernando Prestes de Albuquerque, 1000 — Caieiras/SP</div>
      </div>

      <div class="distancia-card">
        <div class="distancia-number" id="dist-4">
          <span class="distancia-loading">calculando...</span>
        </div>
        <div class="distancia-nome">Ampare I</div>
        <div class="distancia-endereco">Estr. Santa Inês, KM 10.9 — Caieiras/SP</div>
      </div>

      <div class="distancia-card">
        <div class="distancia-number" id="dist-5">
          <span class="distancia-loading">calculando...</span>
        </div>
        <div class="distancia-nome">Thabor</div>
        <div class="distancia-endereco">Rua Avaí, 430 — Parque Santa Inês, Caieiras/SP</div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- CONTATO -->
<section id="contato" style="background: var(--cream-dark); max-width: 100%; padding: 4rem 0;">
  <div style="max-width:960px; margin:0 auto; padding: 0 1.5rem; text-align:center;">
    <p class="section-label">Entre em contato</p>
    <h2 class="section-title" style="margin-bottom:0.5rem;">Reservas e informações</h2>
    <div class="divider" style="margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto;"></div>
    <p style="font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--text-muted); max-width:480px; margin:0 auto 2rem;">
      Para reservas, dúvidas ou mais informações sobre a hospedagem, entre em contato conosco.
    </p>
    <div style="display:flex; gap:1rem; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap;">

<script>
// Calcular distâncias aproximadas usando a fórmula de Haversine
const origem = { lat: -23.337897, lng: -46.654862 };

const destinos = [
  { id: 'dist-1', lat: -23.3518671, lng: -46.6371477 },
  { id: 'dist-2', lat: -23.3382972, lng: -46.6591093 },
  { id: 'dist-3', lat: -23.3930411, lng: -46.6771454 },
  { id: 'dist-4', lat: -23.3999232, lng: -46.6712797 },
  { id: 'dist-5', lat: -23.4087973, lng: -46.6709905 },
];

function haversine(lat1, lng1, lat2, lng2) {
  const R = 6371;
  const dLat = (lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI / 180;
  const dLng = (lng2 - lng1) * Math.PI / 180;
  const a = Math.sin(dLat/2)**2 + Math.cos(lat1*Math.PI/180)*Math.cos(lat2*Math.PI/180)*Math.sin(dLng/2)**2;
  return R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1-a));
}

destinos.forEach(d => {
  const km = haversine(origem.lat, origem.lng, d.lat, d.lng);
  const el = document.getElementById(d.id);
  if (el) {
    if (km < 1) {
      el.innerHTML = Math.round(km * 1000) + '<span class="distancia-unit"> m</span>';
    } else {
      el.innerHTML = km.toFixed(1) + '<span class="distancia-unit"> km</span>';
    }
  }
});

const familiarImgs = [
  document.getElementById('familiar-main') && null
];
const familiarSrcs = [];
window.setFamiliar = function(idx) {
  const main = document.getElementById('familiar-main');
  const thumbs = [document.getElementById('fthumb-0'), document.getElementById('fthumb-1')];
  const srcs = thumbs.map(t => t.querySelector('img').src);
  if (main) main.src = srcs[idx];
  thumbs.forEach((t,i) => t.style.borderColor = i===idx ? 'var(--gold)' : 'transparent');
};
let _fIdx = 0;
window.cycleFamiliar = function() { _fIdx = (_fIdx+1)%2; setFamiliar(_fIdx); };


window.setDuplo = function(idx) {
  const main = document.getElementById('duplo-main');
  const thumbs = [document.getElementById('dthumb-0'), document.getElementById('dthumb-1')];
  const srcs = thumbs.map(t => t.querySelector('img').src);
  if (main) main.src = srcs[idx];
  thumbs.forEach((t,i) => t.style.borderColor = i===idx ? 'var(--gold)' : 'transparent');
};
let _dIdx = 0;
window.cycleDuplo = function() { _dIdx = (_dIdx+1)%2; setDuplo(_dIdx); };

</script>
